mechanism: Copy a causal vault ADD only when aligned with the observed Hyperliquid book, and size the paper position so the trailing 30-minute high-low move implies a fixed 1, 2, or 3 USD risk budget, bounded by visible depth and 600 USD.
temporal_operator: At signal time, compute the high-low range from causal five-level midpoint observations in the preceding 30 minutes only, floor measured volatility at 25 bps, divide the fixed dollar-risk budget by that rate, and cap the result by the smaller visible bid/ask capacity and 600 USD. Reject sizes below 75 USD, then enter after the canonical delay and exit after one hour.
conditioning: at least ten causal midpoint observations in the trailing 30 minutes
maximum trailing observation gap five minutes
notional capped by exact signal-time two-sided five-level depth and 600 USD
maximum one admitted entry per vault and coin per UTC day
canonical taker costs and exact five-level VWAP
only complete causal actual and placebo episodes enter aggregation
execution_translation: Paper-only volatility-targeted taker entry and exit. Position risk is fixed from pre-entry observations and cannot increase from future outcomes. Spread, slippage, adverse latency, and canonical fees are reconciled; no order or collector is used.
prediction_target: At least 4 USD net per TRAIN day with eight trades across three days, profit factor above one, placebo beaten, positive 430-trial-adjusted total lower bound, top positive trade share and largest vault and coin shares at most 60 percent, complete episodes, and bounded per-position pre-entry risk.
falsification_test: Reject if none of the six fixed alignment and dollar-risk variants passes every TRAIN gate. Heldout and forward remain unopened before freeze.
notes: Six TRAIN variants are frozen before outcomes. Finite local CPU execution uses below-normal priority, no GPU, network, collector, or order path.
rationale: V18 passed every TRAIN gate except the multiplicity-adjusted lower bound because its depth-based size concentrated dollar gains in one day. Pre-entry volatility targeting is a causal risk normalization intended to equalize dollar exposure across regimes while retaining the eight-trade diversified sample.
